title: Roofing material suppliers (US and Canada), 2026
notes: PROVISIONAL placeholder data, to be replaced as a data-only change by the distributor catalogs Jack is compiling. Which manufacturers each supplier carries here is a reasonable starting set, not verified per branch. Replace this file (same fields) and nothing else needs to change.
Source data for the price book setup's "Who provides your materials?" step. Which manufacturers each supplier stocks, and how much of each range (line_scope).

line_scope "full_range": a roofing distributor that stocks or orders every line of a brand it carries. "retail_core": a big-box store that stocks a brand's mainstream lines (the setup's default lines) and its common accessories, not designer or specialty lines.

library_supplier names the supplier in materials/roofing-library-data.ts whose observed SKUs and shelf prices (2026-10-12) are used as that supplier's starting costs. A supplier without one starts from the price book's typical costs.
Carriage is by manufacturer at the national level; branches vary. Every list is a starting point the organization edits.

Colours are approximations of each company's brand colour for the setup's column accent, not a logo; where two would look alike side by side (SRS and The Home Depot are both orange), one is shifted so the columns stay distinct. No supplier logo is shipped: a supplier's logo needs that company's permission (the same caveat as the manufacturer logos).

suppliers.name: ABC Supply
suppliers.note: The largest US wholesale distributor of roofing, siding and windows (IBISWorld). Stocks the national shingle brands; PABCO mainly in western branches.

suppliers.name: SRS Distribution
suppliers.regions: United States (Home Depot company since 2024), including Roofing Supply Group branches
suppliers.note: The library's 2026-10-12 research saw SRS branches list GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed, Atlas, IKO and Malarkey items (prices behind a contractor login).

suppliers.name: Beacon (QXO)

suppliers.note: Described as the largest publicly traded distributor of residential and non-residential roofing in the US and Canada before its acquisition by QXO.
